collection.description: A cave seems to whistle whenever the tide is low.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A cave seems to whistle whenever the tide is low.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A scientist finds an opening that could explain the sound.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The sound continues after the opening is blocked, puzzling everyone.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The sound fades as the tide rises, and some feel reassured.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A skeptic hears nothing and remains unconvinced.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The villagers leave nesting animals undisturbed.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Curious children invent increasingly elaborate cave legends.
